fullDescription: A single ANIMATED WEBGL SHADER: Aurora, vertical curtains of anisotropically warped noise. Three phase-offset bands whose x position is displaced by fbm sampled at high frequency across x and low across y, so the curtains stay elongated top to bottom and fall off with height. It is a full-bleed fragment shader with no page around it, about 4KB, no textures, no images and no animation library, and it reacts to the pointer. Drop it behind a hero, a section or a whole page as a living background. Under prefers-reduced-motion it renders one static frame, and it falls back cleanly where WebGL is absent.
prompt:
## Resumo
A full-viewport animated WebGL fragment shader called Aurora: vertical curtains of anisotropically warped noise. Three phase-offset bands whose x position is displaced by fbm sampled at high frequency across x and low across y, so the curtains stay elongated top to bottom and fall off with height. The page contains nothing but the canvas. A shared GLSL preamble provides a hashed value noise, a six-octave fbm and a two-level domain-warp helper; this effect draws on them and adds its own body. Pointer movement raises a smoothed intensity uniform so the effect strengthens under the cursor and relaxes when it leaves.

## Estilo Visual
Ground #07070A with accents ["#6B22A8", "#33EBB8"]. There is no typography and no page chrome: the shader is the entire surface. Keep the palette to two or three values so the effect reads as one material rather than a rainbow.

## Layout e Estrutura

### Canvas
One canvas fixed at inset 0 filling the viewport, with html and body at 100 percent height, margin 0 and overflow hidden. Behind it a hidden panel that is only shown when no WebGL context can be created.

### The shader
Vertical curtains of anisotropically warped noise. Three phase-offset bands whose x position is displaced by fbm sampled at high frequency across x and low across y, so the curtains stay elongated top to bottom and fall off with height.

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### Componente
Full-bleed fragment shader with no surrounding page

### Componente
Smoothed pointer-intensity uniform

### Componente
No-WebGL fallback panel

### Componente
Reduced-motion single-frame path
